items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: he went with O'erah in there... he built his own band like O'erah did.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know what band he was supposed to go with, but anyhow he left him once and he went with O'erah in there. You understand? And he stood a while and I believe he went with some other band from up there and after that I think he built his own band like O'erah did. Yeah, I'm sure of that. I'm not so positive because it was told to me then.
Yeah, well he made records and everything. Yeah.
